Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like giraffes, and some eat food that is very low down, like moles. The Squirrels finish off their picnic, having learned a lot about all the different ways of eating.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now? Duggee offers to repair Delivery Chipmunk’s trike, but that will take too long. The packages need to be delivered right away or else! Duggee also has a delivery badge and he will try to deliver all of Chipmunk’s packages with the help of the Squirrels. Before they begin, they need to learn the rules of delivering. With some hard work, the Squirrels deliver all the packages and Delivery Chipmunk is alright again. The Squirrels have truly earned their delivery badge!

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: With Pearl entranced by Fifi’s glowing tummy mushrooms, Zog fears the worst when Gadabout attempts to mend Boom's wing himself.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Exhausted with requests for help, Looph deliberately disappears. The Piris turn detective, searching the berg with little success until her ingenious plan is finally revealed.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Ruby and Finn play football against Khia’s team. Rafi is goalie, but she keeps missing shots and feels under pressure. She makes a wish for giant hands to save every ball. When the wish ends, Rafi worries she’ll lose, but Ruby and Finn remind her she’s already a great goalie. Believing in herself, Rafi makes a fingertip save on Khia’s penalty and wins the game fairly.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy and the ducklings find an invention that gives them real-life superpowers.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Bananaraptors fall into a hole, and Ginger and Pea-Rexes find a clever way to rescue them.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Team Spidey gets dino power. A ghost haunts the museum.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When a sea turtle loses a chunk of its shell, Tweak and Bud must engineer a solution.

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Hettie discovers a map leading to Blue Whiskers the Pirate's sunken ship and is eager to retrieve it for the museum. It sounds like a job for Stanley, and there's help from pirate fan Benjamin!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea plunges Broccoli and Carrot into the doughnut toppings simultaneously, and Supertato almost quits being a superhero when he can’t save his two friends at the same time.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Ben upgrades the supersuits for flying, but they malfunction halfway through a rescue.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. Ruby and her friends head off to the barbershop to get their hair styled in this Motown music video.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca and Murphi are playing hide-and-seek. Murphi is so difficult to find that he comes out of hiding to help Rebecca make a cardboard tube tracker dog. The Mini Monsters make paper bag monsters, and Rebecca’s Grandpa calls to share his fishing frustrations. The Recycling Express brings a shoebox, inspiring a mega monster idea - a magnificent monster! And the Tiny Helpers are on hand to help make the hutch.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen has hidden some toys in the cafe for Small to find, but she can’t remember where she hid Dog. Old Mother Hubbard comes to visit, Small finds out how mushrooms grow, and the chefs cook up a tortilla pup perfect for their dog-loving guest.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to an old mill. On the way, they go puddle splashing, race sticks in the river, make echoes and escape the snakes!

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Miss Hoolie is planning a cycling holiday around Balamory, but her old bike needs serious TLC. Ava offers to fix it, until a few small repairs turn into a much bigger challenge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing Copy the King when Tag falls over and bumps his knee - ouch! Duggee has his first aid badge, so he can bandage Tag up. The Squirrels want to help, so they practice their bandaging on Tag. They do pretty well at first, but hang on a minute... where has Tag gone? And why is that huge bandage ball rolling down the hill? Hurry up Squirrels - time for a chase!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Shellington and the Vegimals' mission to replant a mangrove forest is put in peril by a school of toothy barracudas.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When her brother has a stomach bug, Pippen is afraid she will catch it because she doesn’t like bugs! Vida teaches her how to feel better - and that it’s not a real bug.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Animated adventure comedy series. A game of hide-and-seek threatens to topple the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia in Turkey.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi promises her dads she will go straight to bed while Aunty T babysits. But when Aunty T suggests night-time ice cream, Rafi makes a wish and her bed magically flies them out into Manchester! It’s exciting at first, but soon Rafi becomes sleepy and wants to go home. Suddenly, the wish runs out and the bed drops onto a tree. Luckily, Aunty T uses her umbrella to magic them safely back. Rafi realises bedtime is bedtime for a reason.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: TapTap’s sister, TipTop, comes for a visit and amazes Yukee with her drumming skills. She is deaf, and she drums just as well as TapTap, making Yukee wonder how she does it. With TipTop’s help, Yukee learns how to feel the music.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: After finding some pasta, the Froglets create a rock band with maracas, a drum and a saxophone.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends are at a racetrack, where they have lots of fun with different types of bicycles. Meanwhile, the Tumbles are getting ready for the Great Golden Egg Race.

programme.title: The Toddler Club
programme.desc: Nigel, Benjee Bear and Bailee Bear welcome toddlers Harley, Haroon, Chester and Leo, and their grown-ups, to the Toddler Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! The What’s in the Box? game reveals a cardboard snake, and when the toddlers and parents open up a bigger box, they discover lots more objects and toys that are inspired by pets. This theme is explored through play, song and story. Grown-ups are encouraged to take part at home by hiding a safe, toddler-appropriate pet toy or object inside a recycled box for them to reveal and explore with their toddler! Storytime is all about joining in with the words, as Benjee Bear and Bailee Bear show how much they love and care for animals. But what pet will Big Bear get for them? Viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring the pets theme too. And, The Toddler Club Bop gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with stretching and the Goodbye song.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Chocolate maker Ali shows the Fact Pack a real cacao pod. They discover where chocolate really comes from, how cacao beans change as they are fermented and dried, and how they become tasty chocolate.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Today, sisters Kyra and Khloe visit a bird centre and meet some friendly owls. With Dad’s help they fly an owl and get it to land on a special protective glove they are holding. Back home, the bird fun continues as the girls make bird masks out of paper plates. But will Mum recognise the two feathered friends flying around the living room?

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Hettie discovers a map leading to Blue Whiskers the Pirate's sunken ship and is eager to retrieve it for the museum. It sounds like a job for Stanley, and there's help from pirate fan Benjamin!

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Game Catchers land on a planet with roads and obstacles that are dotted with signs, which Boxy accidentally collapses. To fix them and play tunnel, they must first clear up a traffic jam.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: It’s the event of the year, Numberland’s Great Bug Race, and Numberblocks One to Four are getting ready to race their pet bugs. The bugs must dash around the edges of different shapes to find out what the perimeter is. Will they stay on track and finish where they started, or will some of the bugs cut corners?

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Green arrives, bringing her natural colour to Colourland. Learn about the colour green.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It’s the day of the annual Teddy Bear Party. Murphi is making sandwiches, and Rebecca has made jelly. A little mishap inspires Murphi’s first monster make – a tiny toadstool pot. The Mini Monsters create paper cup critter puppets, and Rebecca’s cousin, Fiona, calls to share her idea for a cupcake case flower. Murphi’s mega monster make is a teddy bear box, helped by some round boxes brought along by the Recycling Express.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: The Heroes try to make it through a rescue without revealing their identities to Ginger.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers learn all about water butts and why they are good for the environment. They make their own mini water butts by reusing old items, before finding the perfect place to put them in to collect raindrops which can be used to feed thirsty plants. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on a mini eco quest to discover the little things we can do to make a big difference to the environment.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Follow the twists and turns of a brightly coloured straw as it meanders past the wall frames and around the Clubhouse. Next, the Squirrels have prepared a fascinating guessing game, and there's another episode of Agony and Eggstacy. Finally, it is Hedgeley’s birthday, and Duggee wants to prepare something special for him to eat on this important day. After that, King Tiger invites everyone to play copy the king.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create animal masks to pretend to be farm animals, learn signs for farm, old and pig, and sing and sign Old MacDonald Had a Farm.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger can't get a wink of sleep when the baby Pea-Rexes start snoring loudly.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: The Popcasters help Nick finish a song for the Popcast songbook about a busy beaver called Eva. As they sing, Eva is busy beavering away with a surprise for Nick.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Tidbit worries that a watermelon will grow in his tummy after he swallows a seed.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: With Pearl entranced by Fifi’s glowing tummy mushrooms, Zog fears the worst when Gadabout attempts to mend Boom's wing himself.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Dash and Jake set off on a camping adventure, determined to stick to their wizarding scout plan - no wishes allowed! When they realise the original plan won’t work, Rafi suggests making a new one instead. With teamwork, flexibility and the right wish, the Wizard Wagon takes flight and carries them to the perfect camping spot at sunset. Rafi learns that plans can change, and sometimes the best adventures come from making a new one together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Jack’s the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty’s army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat, but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and Cynthia build a bug hotel in Cynthia’s garden and welcome some new residents. JoJo learns that different insects are attracted to different materials and environments in the bug hotel. Ladybirds like straw, beetles like dry leaves and bees like nooks and crannies. Gran Gran gives JoJo her own mini bug hotel for the insects in her own garden.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. The Shallots want to explore beyond the front garden, so Sarah comes up with a plan.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. Charlie loves his little sister Lola and the stories she creates with her imagination. It's Lola's first ever school sports day and, after much deliberation, she decides to enter the egg-and-spoon race - the most difficult race of all. How is she ever going to keep her egg on her spoon? The answer is concentration, and lots of it.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Mr Onion looks inside a book and decides to tell a story to his best friend Dibillo. Everybody enjoys watching the story come to life, especially when Mr Onion makes sure all of his friends are in it!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo flies a paper plane and shows BaBa how to do it. At Play Time, the friends enjoy playing with a glider. The glider drifts down to Yummy Land, where MeMo and BaBa find the Yummies pretending to fly. They have never flown before and would like to try it. MeMo and BaBa take the Yummies on a trip into the sky in GoGo Balloon. On the Lullaby Lake, BaBa gives MeMo a picture to thank them.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Tombliboo Ooo is building a tower of bricks. Tombliboo Eee spots her favourite brick in Ooo's tower and knocks it over trying to get her brick. Ooo is upset about his tower and starts to play sad music on the Tombliboo piano. The sad music makes Eee and Unn sad as well, so they join in. The Tombliboos' sad music makes everybody else in the garden sad. Tombliboo Unn decides to start playing the Tombliboo drums. The Tombliboos begin to play happy music which makes everyone happy again.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Sign along with your friend Mr Tumble as he tells a Bedtime Story all about friendship.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Purple stages a version of Little Red Riding Hood, but can the other Colourblocks stick to the story? Learn about colour mixing with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona and Baba get stuck on the cliff during a storm.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing is teaching Charlie how to throw, but when he throws the ball in the lounge it knocks the fruit over! Bing starts to explain, but Charlie interrupts, leaving Flop to believe Charlie did it. Bing happily shows Charlie how to voosh Squeaky instead, but it flies out of his hands and hits Flop's tray of snacks! After some encouragement, Bing tells Flop the truth and apologises.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny is excited for Love Monster to try carrots, but it turns out he doesn't like them.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Cherry wants to photograph a rare and shy butterfly. The Piggy Builders are eager to help, but they get so competitive that they scare it away. Cherry is heartbroken. To fix their mistake, they will have to work together.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Wasabi eats a rare glownut and attracts all the glowing creatures, who crown him king!

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s the Peas performing their hap-pea double act and showing that, although they look alike, they definitely don’t think alike.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to carry Jackson’s big blue 'chicken' Ludwig (who definitely isn’t a chicken) to the country fair. But the easily-startled bird gets away from them - the chase is on!

programme.title: Chuggington
programme.desc: Chug Patrol is always in control, but when a thunder storm comes to Chuggington, Wilson can't control his fear! Wilson must face his fears and weather the storm to help a friend in need.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato invites Evil Pea to his sleepover, but Carrot is suspicious and vows to stay up all night to make sure she can't unleash any of her evil plans.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'If you break a special thing, you can put it in the Bye Bye Box, and it keeps it safe so you don't ever forget.' Bing plays with a new orange balloon, but when he bounces on it too enthusiastically, it pops. Bing is sad to lose his new toy, so Flop helps him put the balloon fragments in the Bye Bye Box, a memory box where things too broken to be fixed but too special to throw away are kept.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: It's vaccination day! Bing knows it might hurt a little but he is looking forward to the special shiny Hoppity Voosh sticker he will get from Doctor Molly. Bing is brave, but when he goes to get his sticker after his vaccination, he finds out that there are none left! Bing is upset - but then Pando mistakes Bing's disappointment for pain, and Doctor Bing has to help.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it’s King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that ‘finding their talents’ means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don’t understand what he’s doing and think it’s funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are enjoying a relaxing trip along the world’s longest road, the Pan-American Highway, when the road suddenly comes to a stop. They have reached the Darien Gap in Panama, a protected area of great wild beauty. They head off on foot - but little do they know that Glitch is also travelling on the same road and has no intention of leaving his vehicle at all! Can the Go Jetters save this important habitat and protect the local sloths?

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter takes one of Old Brown's tail feathers, a wild chase across the valley ensues to retrieve the feather and pacify the furious owl!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: When a mass of poisonous sea snakes get stranded on a beach, Peso and the Octonauts must somehow get them all back into the ocean.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Pippen loses her voice before her concert. Can Vida help her get it back for her solo?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it’s Bo’s homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Activate with Joe Wicks
programme.desc: Oi, oi! It’s my Treetops Challenge! Are you ready to climb this sky-high challenge all the way to the canopy? We’ll be adventuring low to high, starting with climbers to squats, then star jumps, and finally, the Activate!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble holds a swimming gala, while Justin and his friends enjoy summer at the seaside.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with their cousins, but Muffin won’t give Socks a turn.

programme.desc: It’s the day of the annual Teddy Bear Party. Murphi is making sandwiches, and Rebecca has made jelly. A little mishap inspires Murphi’s first monster make – a tiny toadstool pot. The Mini Monsters create paper cup critter puppets, and Rebecca’s cousin, Fiona, calls to share her idea for a cupcake case flower. Murphi’s mega monster make is a teddy bear box, helped by some round boxes brought along by the Recycling Express.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: The Heroes try to make it through a rescue without revealing their identities to Ginger.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers learn all about water butts and why they are good for the environment. They make their own mini water butts by reusing old items, before finding the perfect place to put them in to collect raindrops which can be used to feed thirsty plants. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on a mini eco quest to discover the little things we can do to make a big difference to the environment.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Follow the twists and turns of a brightly coloured straw as it meanders past the wall frames and around the Clubhouse. Next, the Squirrels have prepared a fascinating guessing game, and there's another episode of Agony and Eggstacy. Finally, it is Hedgeley’s birthday, and Duggee wants to prepare something special for him to eat on this important day. After that, King Tiger invites everyone to play copy the king.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create animal masks to pretend to be farm animals, learn signs for farm, old and pig, and sing and sign Old MacDonald Had a Farm.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger can't get a wink of sleep when the baby Pea-Rexes start snoring loudly.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: The Popcasters help Nick finish a song for the Popcast songbook about a busy beaver called Eva. As they sing, Eva is busy beavering away with a surprise for Nick.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Tidbit worries that a watermelon will grow in his tummy after he swallows a seed.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: With Pearl entranced by Fifi’s glowing tummy mushrooms, Zog fears the worst when Gadabout attempts to mend Boom's wing himself.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Dash and Jake set off on a camping adventure, determined to stick to their wizarding scout plan - no wishes allowed! When they realise the original plan won’t work, Rafi suggests making a new one instead. With teamwork, flexibility and the right wish, the Wizard Wagon takes flight and carries them to the perfect camping spot at sunset. Rafi learns that plans can change, and sometimes the best adventures come from making a new one together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Jack’s the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty’s army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat, but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and Cynthia build a bug hotel in Cynthia’s garden and welcome some new residents. JoJo learns that different insects are attracted to different materials and environments in the bug hotel. Ladybirds like straw, beetles like dry leaves and bees like nooks and crannies. Gran Gran gives JoJo her own mini bug hotel for the insects in her own garden.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. The Shallots want to explore beyond the front garden, so Sarah comes up with a plan.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. Charlie loves his little sister Lola and the stories she creates with her imagination. It's Lola's first ever school sports day and, after much deliberation, she decides to enter the egg-and-spoon race - the most difficult race of all. How is she ever going to keep her egg on her spoon? The answer is concentration, and lots of it.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Mr Onion looks inside a book and decides to tell a story to his best friend Dibillo. Everybody enjoys watching the story come to life, especially when Mr Onion makes sure all of his friends are in it!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo flies a paper plane and shows BaBa how to do it. At Play Time, the friends enjoy playing with a glider. The glider drifts down to Yummy Land, where MeMo and BaBa find the Yummies pretending to fly. They have never flown before and would like to try it. MeMo and BaBa take the Yummies on a trip into the sky in GoGo Balloon. On the Lullaby Lake, BaBa gives MeMo a picture to thank them.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Tombliboo Ooo is building a tower of bricks. Tombliboo Eee spots her favourite brick in Ooo's tower and knocks it over trying to get her brick. Ooo is upset about his tower and starts to play sad music on the Tombliboo piano. The sad music makes Eee and Unn sad as well, so they join in. The Tombliboos' sad music makes everybody else in the garden sad. Tombliboo Unn decides to start playing the Tombliboo drums. The Tombliboos begin to play happy music which makes everyone happy again.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Sign along with your friend Mr Tumble as he tells a Bedtime Story all about friendship.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Rylan faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Has he ever considered a real suntan? Is honesty always the best policy? From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. He reflects on fame, loneliness and coming out, while also helping Natalie figure out how to get her girlfriend down the aisle and revealing whether he and his mum compare notes on guys. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. He reflects on fame, loneliness and coming out, while also helping Natalie figure out how to get her girlfriend down the aisle and revealing whether he and his mum compare notes on guys. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Rylan faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Has he ever considered a real suntan? Is honesty always the best policy? From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. He reflects on fame, loneliness and coming out, while also helping Natalie figure out how to get her girlfriend down the aisle and revealing whether he and his mum compare notes on guys. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Rylan faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Has he ever considered a real suntan? Is honesty always the best policy? From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. He reflects on fame, loneliness and coming out, while also helping Natalie figure out how to get her girlfriend down the aisle and revealing whether he and his mum compare notes on guys. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: The Goonies

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how clever you are? Do you think you might be in the top 50 per cent of the country, the top ten per cent, or even the top one per cent? programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: With trust eroded amongst the group, attention turns to who may be bluffing and if they can keep it up. Battle lines are drawn...

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Rylan faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Has he ever considered a real suntan? Is honesty always the best policy? From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. He reflects on fame, loneliness and coming out, while also helping Natalie figure out how to get her girlfriend down the aisle and revealing whether he and his mum compare notes on guys. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Rylan faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Has he ever considered a real suntan? Is honesty always the best policy? From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. He reflects on fame, loneliness and coming out, while also helping Natalie figure out how to get her girlfriend down the aisle and revealing whether he and his mum compare notes on guys. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Rylan faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Has he ever considered a real suntan? Is honesty always the best policy? From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. He reflects on fame, loneliness and coming out, while also helping Natalie figure out how to get her girlfriend down the aisle and revealing whether he and his mum compare notes on guys. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.desc: Rylan faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Has he ever considered a real suntan? Is honesty always the best policy? From cancelled celebrity friends to the contents of his bedside table, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Rylan opens up about infidelity, heartbreak, estrangement from his father and the breakdown that forced him to take life day by day. He reflects on fame, loneliness and coming out, while also helping Natalie figure out how to get her girlfriend down the aisle and revealing whether he and his mum compare notes on guys. Along the way there are huge laughs, unexpected tangents and moments of real vulnerability as The Assembly push Rylan further than he's ever been pushed before. The episode ends with a powerful performance of his favourite song. Expect chaos, honesty, emotion and a side of Rylan rarely seen on television.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. A group of ten strangers arrive at Danny and Emily’s manor to compete for up to £100 000 in a brand new game where survival depends on not just how smart you are, but how smart others think you are.. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate. The first private pod quiz introduces the show’s central tension: money is earned in secret, then publicly declared and the players must eliminate the person who they believe has contributed the least to the prize pot. Exaggeration, denial and bluffing creep in fast, leaving the group unsure who to trust. When the house must vote for the worst performing player, personal grudges and first impressions start to outway evidence - and with half the prize pot at stake for ejecting the wrong player, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Animated series about CIA agent Stan Smith. Stan and Roger experience life in each other's shoes after Stan is arrested for drink driving and is put under house arrest. After the excitement of a new life stales, they face each other's problems - Roger is under pressure at work and Stan yearns to be needed.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Comedy series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of the lives of working-class teenagers from Liverpool while tackling issues with a refreshing humour. It's Aimee's big night at the opening of the school play, but will she show with deepening problems at home and the rest of school thinking that she posted defamatory TikToks? Meanwhile, Reece's middle-class cousin Tyreece comes to stay with him and Jodie - he's been given a final warning by the police and his mum wants him to get away from the 'bad influence' mates she believes to be the problem, but he wastes no time in stealing some parcels from a delivery van to impress the boys. When Christopher's mum's ring goes missing, Christopher believes Reece took it as he's the only person who knew where he kept it - their burgeoning relationship is rocked as their class assumptions about each other are back to the fore, but Reece is forced to make a tough decision when he discovers who actually did steal the ring.

programme.title: Plebs
programme.desc: Sitcom set in ancient Rome. When a Germanian bar opens over the road and sells a popular drink called beer, the boys attempt to discover the recipe with Grumio engaging his super-palate and Jason seducing barmaid Stefi - meanwhile, Marcus has a run-in with the local fire brigade.

programme.title: Count Abdulla
programme.desc: Comedy series about twenty-something British-Pakistani Muslim doctor Abdulla Khan. After gatecrashing Amrita's sister Preethi's hen night, Abdulla is introduced as Amrita's new Sikh boyfriend and Preethi is beyond excited to welcome him to the family - so much so, in fact, that she insists that he comes to the wedding. Franck is less than pleased that he isn't on the list, but he is determined to make an appearance too in a bid to woo the family - meanwhile, Kathy is on notice from the coven to do away with her Abdulla problem and seeks out old friend and yoga-loving Hindu vampire Rishi. When Abdulla realises what Franck is planning, he makes a mad dash to the wedding to try and intercept him before it's too late - little does he know, though, that Shafi has also turned up to sabotage what he thinks are Abdulla's nuptials at an Indian wedding that lasts long in the memory.

Barnaby and Nelson visit Felicity's mother Valerie and fiance Brogan and they reveal that Felicity was going to confront ufologist Carter Faulkner about an illegal campsite - as they dig deeper, Barnaby and Nelson unearth suspicions, betrayals, and long-buried secrets of a terrestrial nature in their search for the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

As Greg warms down, an unseen assailant throws him from his bike and moves in for the kill... When news comes of the murder, DS Nelson explains the situation to DCI Barnaby while race official Damien Lamerat and local organiser Mary Appleton offer their cooperation and Des outlines the stakes when he tells Barnaby that this race is a make-or-break event for the cyclists. As Barnaby and Nelson investigate, they find themselves drawn into a ruthlessly competitive world of blackmail, bribery and bloodshed where winning comes at any cost.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Crime drama series. Kam finds a broken locket near the body at the murder scene before Barnaby speaks with the family - Brandon's wife Alexandra is shocked, but son Fabian explains that the villagers were opposed to the park and that Brin had formed a group called VASP (Villagers Against the Sculpture Park). After the family deny recognising the locket, Lance claims he got on well with Brandon but fellow artist Simeon Rowling suggests that Brandon upset some artists and critic Daniel Fargo reveals Brandon received hate mail. As Barnaby and Nelson investigate, they have to get creative if they are to crack a case where art imitates death and everything has a deeper meaning.

programme.desc: Rylan faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Has he ever considered a real suntan? Is honesty always the best policy? programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. From the moment they arrive, the players are thrown straight into brain teasing challenges, keeping them occupied outside the gate.
